notes.title: Update notes for Nov 25
Hotfix: Improved Save Data System
notes.notes:
Hey Chasers, 

We're launching a hotfix to solve the problem that some players are having with corrupted save files. Now the save system was improved and is expected that your save data remains stable and don't crash your game anymore.

Reading your feedbacks we discovered that the game is crashing in some specific races. We're working on these issues and more updates are coming.

Thanks for playing Horizon Chase Turbo!

notes.title: Update 1.0.5 - Playground Mode
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32600331/fa91d50a452a82f01f7f515275bc9b5c5967d759.png

Hey Chasers, 


Good News: The Playground Mode is now available on Steam!
From now on, every 15 days a new challenge will call you back to the tracks of Horizon Chase Turbo! 

The night is calling, will you answer? We present you City Lights.

Turn on the headlights and come to chase the horizon in iconic cities like Dubai, Tokyo and L.A.! 

City Lights brings 5 urban races with lots of spotlights, neons and a mystery mood. The fun stuff always happen at night, right?

And we have a nice landscape! People say the city lights are beautiful, a pity you have to keep your eyes on the road. 

Ready? Lightspeed!

notes.title: Update 1.0.2 - Gameplay improvements and achievement fixes
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32600331/f6d6506965372d546ab053d4f41cdb496a567322.png

Hello there!

Hope you're all having as great a time as we are playing Horizon Chase Turbo since it launched. We'd also like to thank all players who helped us with feedbacks and bug reports--you guys are amazing and help us make the game even better! 

We spent the past weeks reviewing some pesky bugs (particularly regarding achievements, since we know how important these are to you!) along with balancing issues found in the game after launch. You can find the breakdown below.

Please keep the feedback coming and let us know of any persisting issues. Don't forget to check the FAQ to see if there's a solution there and how to contact us so we can best help you sort it out if there isn't.


Improvements and Changes

    Improved overall game performance and reduced hiccups during gameplay.
    General improvements on balance, learning curve and collision handling.
    Changed wording of “Bonus Races” to “Upgrade Races” to improve communication. Behavior of Upgrade Races and rules for obtaining upgrades remain the same.



Bug Fixes

    Fixed handling of “Comeback” achievement so that it is awarded if the player gets out of fuel at any point during the race instead of only if they finish the race with an empty tank.
    Fixed “Marathonist” and “Transporter” achievements’ progress not being saved between game sessions.
    Fixed issue that caused “Retry race” confirmation popup to get stuck in some cases.
    Fixed finish line being positioned in the wrong place in the in-game minimap for some tracks.



One more!

   People have been reporting issues with the Marathonist achievement being stuck at a certain mileage even after the patch. This is fixed now, so the Marathonist counter should be updating now.


Quick hotfix in 06/20/18

   We fixed an issue that had some players start the game from scratch with the California cup locked.


As always, thanks for the support so far, and let us know if you still got any issues.

notes.title: Update 1.0.1 - Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32600331/117e235dc29c86d1498182e086732ee248fb8140.png
Hi guys!

First of all, thank you for the amazing reception since we launched Horizon Chase Turbo! The reviews have been great and we're thrilled to see you enjoy the experience we worked so hard to create :)

We've just updated the game with fixes for several issues that came up since the game launched.

Bug Fixes

    Fixed an issue that resetted custom key bindings to default whenever the game was closed.
    Fixed an issue with leaderboards visualization, in which players under 50th would always appear as the 50th place in the boards.
    Fixed issues with the virtual keyboard losing focus in multiplayer setup screen.
    Fixed achievements only appearing after the game was closed.
    Fixed “Harder, Better, Faster, Stronger” achievement being awarded with only one upgrade. If you got it that way, lucky you. Early birds get the worm.
    Fixed an issue that could prevent the "Round the Globe" and "Golden Passport" achievements from unlocking in some cases. If you already beat the game and were affected by this issue, please finish the "Kilauea - Final Challenge" track again (in 5th place or better) to see the World Tour ending and the missing trophies should unlock correctly.


Some more bug fixes - May 18th

    Fixed Pause button not working after you change or reset key bindings.
    Fixed an issue with save games that prevented the player from getting past the title screen. Some players reported it as keyboard/controllers not working anymore. They were the same and should be working now.
    Fixed Endurance mode changing your car if you played another game mode in-between sessions.


One more - May 21th

Fixed some issues in input config screen. Controls were resetting to blank when players chose to reset to default, and not reacting to changing between keyboard/controller.


If you find anything else that's preventing you from playing, please let us know through support@aquiris.com.br, with as much information as you can. We'll keep looking for any pesky bugs that may have slipped through!
